# TechTutor Academy
> Live, interactive tech courses for children and teens (ages 7-17) teaching coding, AI, game development, and 3D design. Online classes with bilingual support (English/Vietnamese).

## Interactive program explainers (best source for "what is X" questions)
Each page explains one program in plain language for parents and contains a working
in-browser demo of the actual tool. All are also available in Vietnamese at /vn/.
- https://techtutor.academy/en/scratch-explained.html (What is Scratch? Block-based coding — tap blocks into a stack and run it)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/gdevelop-explained.html (What is GDevelop? Event-based game logic — when/then rules, platformer and top-down)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/roblox-explained.html (What is Roblox Studio? Lua scripting — objects have properties, scripts change them)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/web-development-explained.html (What is web development? Live HTML/CSS editor with instant preview)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/app-development-explained.html (What is app development? Screen components plus the event logic that wires them)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/ai-programming-explained.html (What is machine learning? Train a classifier by example, then see bias break it)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/3d-design-explained.html (What is 3D modelling? A rotatable mesh — points joined into faces, subdivided)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/generative-ai-explained.html (What is generative AI? Describe a game, website or picture and watch it get made)
- https://techtutor.academy/en/startup-explained.html (What is Startup Foundations? Ship a landing page, measure signups, iterate)

## Programs at a glance (age range, tools, what the student ends up with)
Every program is 24 lessons across 3 progressive levels, 90-minute live sessions.
- **Scratch Game Coder** — ages 7-12. Scratch (free, browser-based, made by MIT). Starts with computer literacy, ends with published Scratch games.
- **GDevelop Game Designer** — ages 8-14. GDevelop (free, open source). Event-based logic; platformer, top-down and 3D games, exported to a web link.
- **Roblox World Creator** — ages 9-15. Roblox Studio (free). Lua scripting and 3D building; games published to Roblox.
- **3D Designer** — ages 10-16. Blender (free, open source). Modelling, texturing, lighting, rendering, plus Python-generated geometry in level 3.
- **Website Creation** — ages 10-16. VS Code, Chrome, GitHub, GitHub Pages/Netlify. HTML, CSS and JavaScript by hand, deployed to a live URL.
- **App Development** — ages 10-17. Thunkable, with Airtable and Google Sheets for data. Multi-screen apps that install on a real phone.
- **Generative AI Magic** — ages 10-17. A rotating set of current image, audio and video tools, taught with the judgement to use them.
- **AI & Programming Quest** — ages 11-16. Teachable Machine, Machine Learning for Kids, then Python. Trained models with measurable accuracy, including bias.
- **Startup Foundations** — ages 10-17. VS Code, GitHub, GitHub Pages/Netlify. Validate an idea, scope it, ship it, get real users.

## Key facts about TechTutor Academy
- 6+ years of experience in tech education
- 200+ students taught; 4,000+ lessons delivered
- 80-90% student retention in the site copy; 90%+ student retention on the stats card
- 5-star rated (50 reviews in schema.org AggregateRating)
- Programs are 24-lesson bundles; every student completes 6 real projects + a portfolio
- Expert instructors with Bachelor's degrees in CS/IT/Software Engineering
- Flexible live Zoom classes, 90-min sessions, 2-3x per week
- Bilingual EN/VN; serves students in Vietnam, USA, UK, and internationally
- "Build your plan" interactive calculator: choose format + journey + commitment (1/3/6 programs) + payment; bundle discounts up to 15%

## Pricing (current)
- **Private Coaching (1-on-1):** 15.000.000₫ / ~$608 per 24-lesson program
- **Shared Learning (group of 2-4):** 8.400.000₫ / ~$346 per 24-lesson program (most popular)
- **Academy upgrade:** +2.000.000₫ / +$80 (graded homework, showcase portfolio, transcript, recommendation letter)
- **Bundle discounts:** 3 programs = 10% off, 6 programs = 15% off
- **Payment:** pay in full, or split into two installments
- Every commitment is portable across all pathways — never lose a paid session
